data.name: The Official Hollywood Sign Walking Tour in Los Angeles-Free Waters!
data.headline: For all ages! • 2.5 Hours • Up to 30 People
data.description:
#Come celebrate the 100th Year Anniversary of the Hollywood Sign-the most iconic attraction on the West Coast!			

##About					
We’ll take you to the front of and behind (TO THE TOP) the Hollywood sign for an unforgettable experience! With tons of opportunities for ELITE Instagram photos, insider Hollywood History, and a local guide who actually works in Show Business, this hike brags some of the best views in LA. Snag a bird’s eye view of top film studios Disney, Warner Bros., Paramount, Dreamworks, the Hollywood Walk of fame, and more! 

Your Guide will tell you story after story that will make you forget you're actually walking up a hill. 
					
##More info					
- Hollywood Sign Panoramic 360° views of all of LA 
- The Best Photos by our Professional Photographer Tour Guides
- Enjoy incredible storytelling from working actors, comedians, and musicians!
data.cancellation_notes: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience.
